title: Latvian Welfare Minister caught drunk driving, removed from office
summary_full: The board of the Union of Greens and Farmers (ZZS) has decided, at an extraordinary meeting, to remove Reinis Uzulnieks from his post as Minister for Welfare, according to ZZS press secretary Dace Līce, Latvian Television reported Sunday, 13 September.
